- **Interactive Scripts**:
  - [`main.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/main.js): Mobile navigation drawer, universal toast notification system, and modal handling.
  - [`portfolio.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/portfolio.js): Category filtering and dynamic modal case studies.
  - [`blog.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/blog.js): Instant live search across all articles.
  - [`resources.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/resources.js): Category filters and instant downloads.
  - [`sound-player.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/sound-player.js): Web Audio synthesis engine for AMM Sounz track playback.

> - Update button link or label to: *[Your text]*
>

#### Option 2: Casual Messages One-by-One
You don't have to write everything at once. Feel free to send one change at a time, review how it looks on the live link, and then move to the next.

#### Option 3: Screenshots or Marked-Up Images
If it's visual or easier to show than explain, you can take a screenshot of any page on your screen, circle or mark what you want changed, and attach it here!
